topic: The Finance Portal outage this morning

facts.text: The Finance Portal is down for all users; the outage started at 07:58.
Updates are posted on the IT status page; staff should not raise individual tickets.
3 open tickets are about the Finance Portal, plus a P1 incident in progress.
A 503 error means the portal's servers are unavailable; users cannot fix it themselves.
Raising individual tickets during a known outage slows the response.

open_questions: When the next status update will be posted
